facts.F66: Q2: every saved report's Now is snapped to Then's length once. Then and its frozen values, and past PDF exports, are untouched. No notice to owners, also where a snapped report newly overlaps.
facts.F67: Q3: the {Throughput} Total line gets change and % change; per day keeps its own; Total counts in CHANGE. Both 0 reads 'No change (both 0)' (no arrow, no %, no change). Then 0 and Now > 0 keeps '▲ N (Then was 0)'. Not captured: no change. % rounding as 5878 defines. Per day showing no change while Total moves by 1 is accepted. Reverses 5878 D53's rule that the Total line carries no change mark and does not count.

facts.F72: 5878 decisions reversed or reshaped: D43 (separate saved Now length), D59 and D62 (the Now step), D19 (create flow loses its Now step), D44 and AC-10.2 (Now length editable), D63 (Edit opens on Now; now opens on Metrics & name), D53 (Total excluded from CHANGE). D47's per-day comparison stays, its unequal-length reason no longer applies. D21 and D37 Then validation kept; a valid Then always fits a Now of the same length.
facts.F73: Whether the snap migration bumps the report's concurrency version: with a bump, an Edit open at that moment is refused as stale even if nothing was changed; without it, an old browser page resending Now 45 is refused by the Q5 rule. Also the gap between deploy and migration. (Quint S2 traces.)
facts.F74: Quint evidence: quint 0.33.1, model baseline.qnt sha256 88a325f5...0477f and s1grid.qnt sha256 f4615960...dac92, quint run --max-steps 12 --max-samples 20000/50000 --seed 6625, deterministic renderer render.py; random simulation, not exhaustive; model day 1000 = 2026-11-15. Invariants held: Now length = Then length after migration; overlap message iff a shared day; until-date = Then's last day; change only when both totals captured; % only when Then > 0; API accepts only equal or absent Now; Then >= 14 days and not after today. Helper assumptions: check order length, after today, kept history, Now rule; per day rounded to tenths (shipped panel uses 2 decimals, so the 41-of-61 'per day unchanged while Total moves' figure overstates the frequency; behaviour accepted either way); % half away from zero.

Context map: Reports context only (reads Flow metrics as today); no new glossary terms; no domain events; UI surfaces = Reports tab of {Team}/{Portfolio} pages (ADR-271) and the app-level Reports page.
